eyebrow: Athena in a data science workflow

code:
SELECT plan,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(AVG(churned), 3) AS churn
FROM customers GROUP BY plan;

-- basic  24849  0.190
-- plus   15210  0.186
-- pro     9941  0.193
caption: Run locally on synthetic data; Athena SQL is similar.
Key-based sampling keeps experiments reproducible.

code:
CREATE TABLE churn_features
WITH (format = 'PARQUET',
  external_location =
    's3://my-ds-bucket/processed/v1/')
AS
SELECT customer_id, tenure_months,
       churned
FROM customers;
caption: Illustrative: the S3 location must be empty.

code:
import awswrangler as wr

df = wr.athena.read_sql_query(
    "SELECT * FROM churn_features",
    database="churn_db")
caption: Illustrative: needs an AWS account and IAM access.

subtitle: The data warehouse side of ML on AWS.
